strings.zh: 雷电球『Vor——to！

strings.zh: 真的搞不懂那些钓鱼的,{NEWLINE}来这里钓半天鱼最终却空手而归,{CLEAR}有什么意思吗？{SCROLL}像我这样直接用雷电球电鱼,{NEWLINE}事半功倍收获多多,{CLEAR}这才是聪明的做法！

strings.zh: 前段时间火箭队来到这附近时,{NEWLINE}我也上去跟他们作战来着,{CLEAR}但是我的精灵们却……{CLEAR}却被火箭队的头目残忍杀害了。{SCROLL}看到往日的伙伴被烧成焦炭,{NEWLINE}我……我……{CLEAR}我一想起那个家伙的脸就颤抖不已。
strings.en: When Team Rocket came around here a{NEWLINE}while back, I went up and battled them.{CLEAR}But my Pokémon... My Pokémon were{CLEAR}brutally killed by the Rocket boss.{SCROLL}Seeing my old partners burned to{NEWLINE}charcoal... I... I... Just thinking of{CLEAR}that guy’s face makes me shake.

strings.zh: 什么？想跟我进行精灵对战？{SCROLL}不行不行,我的全部主力{NEWLINE}都在那场战斗中被杀害了,{CLEAR}现在的伙伴还太弱了。{SCROLL}而且我现在一想到精灵对战{NEWLINE}就害怕地发抖,{CLEAR}今后我可能不会再进行精灵对战了。
strings.en: What? You want a Pokémon battle with{NEWLINE}me?{SCROLL}No, no. All my best Pokémon were killed{NEWLINE}in that battle. My current partners are{CLEAR}still too weak.{SCROLL}Besides, just thinking about Pokémon{NEWLINE}battles makes me shake with fear now. I{CLEAR}might never battle again.

strings.zh: 你不想给死去的伙伴报仇了吗？

strings.zh: 你该像个男子汉一样振作起来！

strings.zh: 你就是个没用的胆小鬼！

strings.zh: 你还有女朋友呢,你不是一个人。

strings.en: Just thinking of that red-haired Team{NEWLINE}Rocket man’s face makes me shake.{CLEAR}Revenge? I can’t even imagine it.

strings.zh: 男不男子汉的无所谓了,{NEWLINE}能活下去就好……

strings.zh: 经过这次的事情,{NEWLINE}我已经认识到我就是个胆小鬼了,{CLEAR}不用你再提醒我了,谢谢。

strings.zh: 没错……我不是一个人,{NEWLINE}我还有爱人要去保护,{CLEAR}如果我继续这么沉沦下去,{CLEAR}那下次危机来临时谁来保护她呢。{CLEAR}谢谢你的提醒,{CLEAR}我确实有些消极过头了。{SCROLL}那么我接受你的挑战,{NEWLINE}来一场精灵对战吧！
strings.en: You’re right... I’m not alone. I have{NEWLINE}someone I love to protect. If I keep{CLEAR}wallowing like this, who’ll protect her{CLEAR}the next time danger comes?{SCROLL}Thanks for the reminder. I really was{NEWLINE}being way too negative.{SCROLL}All right, I accept your challenge.{NEWLINE}Let’s have a Pokémon battle!

strings.zh: 果然还是不行……{NEWLINE}我这糟糕的指挥{CLEAR}导致了伙伴们失败,被杀……{SCROLL}啊啊啊啊啊！我是个无能之人啊。
strings.en: I knew it, I still can’t... My lousy calls{NEWLINE}got my partners beaten, and killed...{SCROLL}Aaaaargh! I’m worthless!

strings.zh: 哈哈,我竟然赢了？{NEWLINE}看来我也不是那么弱嘛。{CLEAR}谢谢你帮我重拾信心,{CLEAR}我原本真的是消极过头了。{SCROLL}以后我会振作起来{NEWLINE}保护好我的女朋友和精灵们！
strings.en: Ha ha, I actually won? Guess I’m not so{NEWLINE}weak after all. Thanks for helping me{CLEAR}get my confidence back. I really was{CLEAR}being way too negative.{SCROLL}From now on, I’ll pull myself together{NEWLINE}and protect my girlfriend and Pokémon!

strings.zh: 我一定可以重回巅峰,重新变强的！
strings.en: I can make it back to the top. I’ll get{NEWLINE}strong again!

strings.zh: 我男朋友曾经像个英雄一样{NEWLINE}与做坏事的火箭队战斗。{CLEAR}但也就是在那一场战斗中,{CLEAR}他的精灵被火箭队给杀害了……{CLEAR}从那以后他就无精打采自暴自弃。{SCROLL}我看到他这个样子真的好心疼,{NEWLINE}如果可以的话,{CLEAR}请你跟我男朋友进行一场精灵对战{CLEAR}帮他重拾信心好吗？拜托了！
strings.en: My boyfriend once fought the evil Team{NEWLINE}Rocket like a hero. But in that battle,{CLEAR}Team Rocket killed his Pokémon... Ever{CLEAR}since then, he’s been listless and has{CLEAR}given up on himself.{SCROLL}It breaks my heart to see him like this.{NEWLINE}If you can, please have a Pokémon{CLEAR}battle with my boyfriend and help him{CLEAR}get his confidence back. Please!

strings.zh: 谢谢你！谢谢你！{NEWLINE}我又在男朋友脸上看到了往日的自信！{CLEAR}真的不知道该怎么感谢你才好。{SCROLL}这是我珍藏很久的道具,送给你吧！
strings.en: Thank you! Thank you! My boyfriend{NEWLINE}looks as confident as he used to! I{CLEAR}don’t know how to thank you.{SCROLL}This is an item I’ve treasured for a{NEWLINE}long time. Please take it!

strings.zh: 谢谢你！谢谢你！{NEWLINE}我又在男朋友脸上看到了往日的自信！{CLEAR}真的不知道该怎么感谢你才好。{SCROLL}这是我珍藏很久的道具,送给你吧！
strings.en: Thank you! Thank you! My boyfriend{NEWLINE}looks as confident as he used to! I{CLEAR}don’t know how to thank you.{SCROLL}This is an item I’ve treasured for a{NEWLINE}long time. Please take it!

strings.zh: 我也要努力变强,{NEWLINE}不能拖男朋友的后腿！

strings.zh: 我来这里本来是想{NEWLINE}静静地钓个鱼的。{CLEAR}结果那边那个黄毛小子{CLEAR}带着个雷电球来轰隆隆地电鱼！{SCROLL}这家伙难道不知道{NEWLINE}这里是钓鱼圣地寂静之桥吗？{CLEAR}真是个没素质的家伙。{SCROLL}可惜我的水系精灵打不过他的雷电球,{NEWLINE}不然我肯定好好教育教育他！

What a lowlife.{SCROLL}Too bad my Water types are no match{NEWLINE}for his Voltorb, or I’d teach that brat{CLEAR}a real lesson!

strings.zh: 我本来是被请来赶走卡比兽的,{NEWLINE}却被卡比兽逼到角落里无法动弹。{CLEAR}这只精灵真的是太厉害了！{SCROLL}要想赶走卡比兽的话,{NEWLINE}必须要使用精灵之笛才行,{CLEAR}听说紫苑镇的富士老人那里{CLEAR}就有精灵之笛,{CLEAR}能麻烦你去借精灵之笛来{CLEAR}赶走这只卡比兽吗？
strings.en: I was hired to chase off Snorlax, but it{NEWLINE}backed me into a corner and I can’t{CLEAR}move. That Pokémon is really something!{SCROLL}To chase Snorlax away, you need the{NEWLINE}Poké Flute. I heard Mr. Fuji in Lavender{CLEAR}Town has one. Could you borrow the{CLEAR}Poké Flute and drive this Snorlax off?

strings.zh: 厉害厉害,{NEWLINE}面对那样强大的卡比兽都面无惧色！{CLEAR}我对您的实力非常佩服,{CLEAR}如果不嫌弃的话,{CLEAR}可以跟我比试比试吗？{SCROLL}
strings.en: Amazing, amazing! You faced that mighty{NEWLINE}Snorlax without flinching! I truly{CLEAR}admire your strength.{SCROLL}If you don’t mind, would you have a{NEWLINE}match with me?{SCROLL}

strings.zh: 是吗……那真是太遗憾了。
strings.en: I see... That’s truly a shame.

strings.zh: 如此,便得罪了！
strings.en: Then, have at you!

strings.zh: 您真是太厉害了,{NEWLINE}有时间的话请多来指点我几招。

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『请不要再电鱼了好吗？{NEWLINE}会影响到周围的钓客的。{CLEAR}而且往水里不断使用电系技能,{CLEAR}对水系的口袋妖怪们也不好啊。

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『喂喂喂！！！{NEWLINE}你能不能有点公德心啊！{CLEAR}你在这里电鱼,别人还怎么钓啊？{CLEAR}而且就这么往水里扔电系技能,{CLEAR}会对水系口袋妖怪造很大伤害的！

strings.zh: 真有意思,{NEWLINE}谁规定不准在这里电鱼了？{CLEAR}你凭什么来管我啊？

Aaah!!! You...

strings.zh: 这美纳斯是因为受不了我电鱼{NEWLINE}才出现在这里的吗？{CLEAR}真的是太可怕了,{CLEAR}看样以后得收着点了。

strings.zh: 美纳斯把人给撞飞了！！！

strings.zh: 我有一位朋友住在在浅红市,{NEWLINE}她虽然年纪小,{CLEAR}却是一个很厉害的忍者哦。{SCROLL}我也跟她学过几招忍术,{NEWLINE}你要见识一下吗？
